run_get_energies: run the script to extract potential energies from VASP relaxation trajectories across subdirectories
extract_file: extract a specific file from a ZIP archive to a target directory
process_func: process VASP trajectory files in parallel to extract final potential energy values
refactor_process_func: refactor process_func to support additional trajectory formats beyond VASP XML
review_extract_file: review extract_file to add error handling for missing or corrupt ZIP files
